listing.name: CyberMage: Darklight Re-Awakening
listing.summary: Use a permitted existing CyberMage player with your own DOS game files.

steps.title: Use a permitted existing Windows player
steps.instruction: If you already have a permitted Windows copy, select cybermage.exe with its containing folder as the working directory. Choose Play explicitly. The player runs the original x86 code through an interpreter with native services; this does not prevent useful existing-copy registration.

steps.title: Supply the original once in the game
steps.instruction: The game accepts your own CyberMage DOS v1.01F ISO 9660 .iso or CM_HI.EXE from its CYBERMAG folder. BIN/CUE and other executable versions are outside this input contract. Its first-Play picker verifies and copies required files to iso/CYBERMAG beside the player without changing the original. It does not import original DOS saves/settings or require optional SC-55 firmware.

steps.title: Keep the working folder and its data
steps.instruction: The upstream player owns runtime replacement and setup. Keep iso/CYBERMAG, run and NATIVE.CNF backed up with the application closed; a custom --root uses that chosen data root instead. Existing imported destinations are not overwritten automatically; retain a working folder before following upstream repair instructions. Portcove registration leaves all files external and provides no managed update, backup or rollback.

listing.download_block_reason: Fresh acquisition remains held pending clarification or a clean official package for the embedded commercial Darklight icon. Upstream THIRD_PARTY_NOTICE.md explicitly excludes it from the MIT grant and supplies no redistribution permission. This does not classify the interpreted player as unsupported or transfer rights to an existing copy.
